references.text: Moses commanded that the armed men from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half-tribe of Manasseh should cross over Jordan ahead of their brothers to help them.
Moses promised the descendants of Reuben and Gad that they could have the land east of Jordan if they went armed before the Lord to war.
The agreement that the armed men from the eastern tribes would cross over Jordan ahead of the Lord to war.
Moses reminded the tribes that the armed men should cross over Jordan ahead of their brothers.
Joshua reminded Reuben, Gad, and half-tribe of Manasseh of their obligation to go armed ahead of their brothers.
Parallel passages stating that the men from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half-tribe of Manasseh went armed ahead of the Israelites.
Jericho as the target of Israel's military campaign, the city they were now approaching on the plains of Jericho.
